episode_title: Leveraging Incremental Improvement for Major Gains with Alex Nottingham
question: How much monthly revenue do dental practices lose from missed phone call conversions on average?
transcript_excerpt: According to the ADA, the average new patient value for the first year is $642. The average office receives 135 new patient opportunities per month, but only one third book appointments (87 calls). This results in over $55,000 of missed revenue per month. With incremental improvement of just one additional converted call per working day, practices can gain approximately $120,000 annually ($10,000 per month multiplied by 12 months).

episode_title: Leveraging Incremental Improvement for Major Gains with Alex Nottingham
question: What is the All Star Dental Academy business growth formula for doubling a dental practice?
transcript_excerpt: According to the business growth formula, there are four ways to make money: marketing to make the phone ring, converting the phone call, ensuring the patient shows up, and getting them to refer. If you improve each of these areas by 5% incrementally, you will grow your business 40%. If you can improve each area by 12%, you will double your business. This concept is based on Kaizen, the Japanese principle of growth through incremental improvement.
